name: status-icon
title: Status Icon
description: A small workflow status icon in Linear's set — backlog, todo, in progress, in review, done, canceled, duplicate, triage — each a hand-drawn 16-unit glyph in a semantic color.

meta.whenToUse: Indicate the workflow state of a task or issue — backlog, todo, in progress, in review, done, canceled, duplicate, triage — alongside a label.
meta.whenNotToUse: Measurable progress (Progress), generic loading (Spinner), or priority (PriorityIcon).
